Text:
# DIARRHEA WITH GIARDIA

Treatment can be offered when the patient has symptomatic disease. Treatment of asymptomatic patients can be considered if they have contact with immunocompromised or pregnant people or live or work in settings where there is risk of spreading infection to others (e.g., food handlers, daycare, nursing home).

## Primary treatment

## Inpatient

Hydration and electrolyte replacement

## Antimicrobial treatment
Metronidazole 250 mg PO q8h for 5 to 7 days [DI]

## Outpatient

Hydration and electrolyte replacement
